# Spectra Desk

> The public web, as a brief.

- Version: source 10.0.1 Channel. Windows installer files remain the hashed 9.0.0 Corroborate build.
- Site: https://spectradesk.jonbailey.xyz/
- License: MIT
- Platform: Windows 10 / 11, 64-bit

## What it is

A free Windows OSINT desk. A name, email, or username becomes a sourced client brief. It multiplies anchors and divides homonyms. Every capture is SHA-256. Toolkit catalog: 898 public search tools. Fast mode is capped at 12 queries.

## What it is not

Not legal proof of identity. Not a login bypass. Not a private-data broker. Not a subscription. The machine does not LOCK.

## Install

GitHub release v10.0.1 attaches Spectra-Desk-Setup-9.0.0.exe and Spectra-Desk-Portable-9.0.0-win64.zip with SHA256SUMS.txt. Those bytes are still the hashed unsigned 9.0.0 Corroborate build. If those asset URLs are not HTTP 200, the site download page says so and does not pretend the files exist.

## Agent surface

```
spectra intake
spectra divide
spectra brief
spectra lock
spectra export
spectra doctor
spectra toolkit
spectra case
```

MCP tools include intake, divide, brief, lock, export_case, doctor, toolkit_search, case_desk. lock refuses. Agents can draft. Agents cannot LOCK.
